title: OracleCompletionValidation
description: Machine-checkable receipt for Oracle's independent, read-only Completion Validation. Binds a PASS/BLOCK verdict to the exact reconstructed scope, the exact artifact/diff set inspected, and the sources actually consulted — so a verdict can never be asserted (in prose) without Oracle having run, and a later auditor can verify a delivery was actually validated. Oracle reconstructs scope from raw user turns and distrusts implementer prose; this receipt is what Oracle itself emits, not what an implementer reports on Oracle's behalf.

verdict.description: Only incorrect requested behavior, regression, data loss, or concrete safety failure may justify BLOCK. Taste, adjacent concerns, missing ceremony, and absent receipts never block (doctrine/oracle.md).

rawUserTurns.description: Verbatim user requests/turns Oracle reconstructed scope from. Never implementer summaries or paraphrase.

reconstructedScope.description: Oracle's own statement of what was actually asked for, independent of any implementer claim.

userExclusions.description: Anything the user explicitly excluded from this delivery's scope.

scopeCorrections.description: Mid-task scope narrowing/correction turns Oracle accounted for.

description.description: What was validated: a diff, an artifact, a delivered answer.

digest.description: Digest binding this verdict to the exact artifact/diff set Oracle inspected. A verdict whose subject digest does not match the current state of the delivery is stale and must not be treated as current; re-validate against the current delivery before relying on the earlier verdict.

units.description: Optional per-file breakdown of the subject digest, when the subject is a multi-file diff.

sourcesInspected.description: Sources Oracle actually inspected (source files, tests read but not run, live consumers). Empty is invalid: a validation that found nothing to check has not checked anything.

violatedRequirement.description: The specific requirement, from the reconstructed scope, this defect violates.

findings.description: Required and non-empty when verdict is BLOCK: a BLOCK with zero findings is invalid. Empty on PASS.

repairCount.description: Doctrine caps Completion Validation at one repair attempt.

recheckCount.description: Doctrine caps Completion Validation at one recheck. A second BLOCK escalates to Adrian rather than issuing a further recheck.

escalated.description: True once the one-repair-one-recheck cap is exhausted and the second BLOCK has been escalated.
